00065 void LFSawUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, 
00066           const unsigned int blockID, 
00067           const int channel) throw()
00068 { 
00069  double twoOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * 2.0;
00070  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00071  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00072  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073  
00074  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00075  {
00076   *outputSamples++ = currentPhase;
00077   currentPhase += *freqSamples++ * twoOverSampleRate;
00078   
00079   if(currentPhase >= 1.f)   currentPhase -= 2.f;
00080   else if(currentPhase < -1.f) currentPhase += 2.f;
00081  }
00082 }

00091 void LFSawUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00092 { 
00093  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00094  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00095  double blockSizeOverSampleRatex2 = 2.0 * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * krBlockSize;
00096  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00097  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00098  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00099  
00100  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00101  
00102  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00103  {
00104   float nextValue = value;
00105   
00106   if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00107   {
00108    nextValue = currentPhase;
00109    
00110    currentPhase += *freqSamples * blockSizeOverSampleRatex2;
00111    
00112    if(currentPhase >= 1.f)   currentPhase -= 2.f;
00113    else if(currentPhase < -1.f) currentPhase += 2.f;
00114   }
00115   
00116   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00117   
00118   blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00119   freqSamples   += numKrSamples;
00120   
00121   if(nextValue == value)
00122   {
00123    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00124    {
00125     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00126     --numSamplesToProcess;
00127     --numKrSamples;
00128    }
00129   }
00130   else
00131   {
00132    float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00133    
00134    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00135    {
00136     *outputSamples++ = value;
00137     value += valueSlope;
00138     --numSamplesToProcess;
00139     --numKrSamples;
00140    }
00141    
00142    value = nextValue;
00143   }
00144  }
00145 }

00148 LFSaw::LFSaw(UGen const& freq, Buffer const& initialPhase) throw()
00149 { 
00150  int numChannels = ugen::max(freq.getNumChannels(), initialPhase.size());
00151  
00152  initInternal(numChannels);
00153  
00154  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00155  {
00156   internalUGens[i] = new LFSawUGenInternal(freq, initialPhase.wrapAt(i));
00157  }
00158 }
